rows.reference_summary: US authorities have charged Takeshi Ebisawa, alleged to be a senior member of the Japanese Yakuza crime syndicate, with conspiring to traffic nuclear materials, attempting to sell uranium and plutonium to what he believed were Iranian agents for a nuclear bomb. Ebisawa and a Thai co-defendant, Somphop Singhasiri, face life imprisonment if convicted, with Ebisawa also accused of seeking to acquire military-grade weapons for a Myanmar rebel group. The nuclear materials, sourced from Myanmar, were seized in Thailand and confirmed to contain uranium and weapons-grade plutonium by a US laboratory.
